title: Architecture made for remembrance
text: The Ahar cenotaphs commemorate members of Mewar’s ruling family. Their domed pavilions, known as chhatris, turn remembrance into architecture. Repeated columns and roof forms make individual memorials part of a larger landscape. This is a commemorative place rather than a palace; a quiet, respectful visit suits its purpose.
